reviewed_items.reviewer_notes: All 3 gates passed: route is a public Next.js HTTP handler (Gate 1 exception) and the finding is a missing-validation type; no trust_assumptions key exists in BUG_BOUNTY_SCOPE.json and the entry point is unauthenticated browser traffic (Gate 2 N/A); src/app/auth/ is explicitly in-scope (Gate 3 passes). Spec deviation confirmed — RFC 6749 §10.12 state parameter check is entirely absent from the callback. Attack path is conditional: PKCE normally prevents code injection by binding the authorization code to a code_verifier cookie, so exploitation requires PKCE to be bypassed or absent; therefore CONFIRMED_POTENTIAL rather than CONFIRMED_VULNERABILITY. An attacker can attempt this via the /auth/callback GET endpoint by injecting their own authorization code into a victim's browser session, causing account takeover if PKCE fails or is unavailable.
